decisions.reason: Both actual published suppliers declare domain: mathematics. The affine model supplies geometric data only, and observer-decomposition clause (c) proves the positive-definite three-dimensional rest space. Independently checked cross-product domination, componentwise Lebesgue integrability, unit-vector scalarization and positive Mc division; no physical premise enters.

Step 1.2 used the Lebesgue L1 triangle inequality on the Riemann integral supplied by FTC, with no comparison bridge. Repaired by proving pointwise Riemann comparison from Darboux lower/upper sums and evaluating the bounding primitives. Also confined Q,d,B to the support ball where b is defined, and proved integrability of rho times the continuous remainder before the final Lebesgue estimate.

TD used m after defining it only under the Pirani branch. Defined m=-g(p,U)/c2 explicitly in the TD branch and its positivity from future timelike pairing. Independently substituted n=p/mu into the zero-torque SSC identity, checked En=c mu and gamma=mc/mu, and removed S p times Dmu only through TD. This gives the unchanged intended mc2 p=mu2 U+S Dp identity.

A1 incorrectly attributed both equations to the BMT postulate. The Example already explicitly assumes local-potential action stationarity and lists the action-equivalence supplier, so its deduction is sound with that premise; the attribution defect is nonfatal. Repaired Given, A1 and F3 to state finite-segment C2 fixed-endpoint stationarity and distinguish adopted spin law from derived translation. Checked G=0, G=1, metric symmetry, preserved orthogonality and spin norm.

The invariant theorem assumes TD along the solution; its interface cannot alone justify preservation from the initial state. Added the existing local-closure lemma directly as F3 and a mathematical dependency, applied its initial-constraint preservation first, and then applied the invariant theorem. Checked the closure proof homogeneous constraint equation and uniqueness, the invariant theorem positive spatial tensor-norm argument at initial zero spin, and the resulting constant-mu geodesic reduction. The Example claim is preserved without extra assumptions.

proposed_updates.subject: def-rpm-body-moments
proposed_updates.finding: Clause (b) asserts parametrization independence of sqrt(det G) dy without an exact change-of-variables supplier or local transformation proof. Under X-prime=X composed with phi, the chain rule gives G-prime=Dphi-transpose G Dphi and sqrt(det G-prime)=abs(det Dphi) sqrt(det G). The remaining measure equivalence requires the C1 diffeomorphism substitution theorem; insert that exact supplier and identity. No assigned conditional SSC calculation relies on proving this measure equality.

proposed_updates.subject: pthm-rpm-td-invariants

Conserved zero spatial norm implies S=0. Qualify the Remark as excluding the unrestricted indefinite tensor norm alone; the conditional theorem proof and spinless consuming use remain sound.
